postDescription: Viral TikTok: a block of feta in the middle of a dish of cherry tomatoes, olive oil and garlic. Into 'a hot oven', then stirred into pasta.

verify.headline: Behind the viral bake.
verify.reasoning: The method is plausible. Hot tomatoes release juice; softened feta makes a sauce.
skips: Use 200°C / 180°C fan, not just “a hot oven”.
Cook pasta separately; save a mug of its water.
Taste before salting — feta is already salty.

sourcesToCheck.name: BBC Good Food
sourcesToCheck.why: Baked feta pasta · method & oven guidance

sourcesToCheck.name: Serious Eats
sourcesToCheck.why: Pasta water · how a sauce comes together

steps.title: Prep
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200°C / 180°C fan. Put the tomatoes and peeled garlic in a baking dish, set the feta block in the middle and pour over the oil. Add pepper.
steps.lookFor: Feta in the centre, tomatoes in one layer around it, everything glossy with oil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.instruction: Bake feta, tomatoes, garlic and oil for 25 min at 200°C / 180°C fan.
steps.lookFor: Burst tomatoes and a soft, lightly golden feta.

steps.title: Boil pasta
steps.instruction: Meanwhile cook the penne in well-salted boiling water for 1 minute less than the packet says. Save a mug of pasta water, then drain.
steps.lookFor: Pasta bends but still has a slight bite in the centre.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Mash the feta and tomatoes into a sauce, add the pasta and a splash of pasta water, and stir until glossy. Tear over the basil and taste before adding salt.
steps.lookFor: Pasta evenly coated in a creamy pink-orange sauce, no dry patches.
